tools.name: list_buyer_programmes
tools.description: List verified buyer programmes (and other sources) from a public baseline. Returns name, url, band, referral, categories, status, notes, and type. An empty list means no rows matched — programmes are never invented.

tools.name: get_programme
tools.description: Look up one verified programme by exact or fuzzy name. A miss returns match_kind=none — this tool does not invent a programme.

tools.name: demand_mix
tools.description: Return hot demand categories recorded on a public baseline. mention_count values are heuristics copied from the JSON cut, not hit counts. This tool never invents additional categories or counts.

tools.name: latest_brief
tools.description: Return the public Frontier Signal brief markdown for a date. Gated watchlist sections are stripped if present. A brief is never synthesised.

tools.name: deltas
tools.description: Return deltas_vs_prev (and recheck notes, if any) for a baseline cut. These are the change notes recorded on that JSON file. This tool does not compute new diffs.

tools.name: list_observed_dates
tools.description: List baseline dates (and public brief dates) available in this checkout. No live fetch is performed.
